meta.title: Project Nighthawk
meta.note: Illustrative dataset. Entities and asset records are fictional; the taxonomy, cross-dependency structure and protection rationales model how a real dual-use trade secret register is organised.
meta.embeddedIn: infographics/nighthawk-trade-secrets.js — keep the two in step

secrets.label: DWCP
secrets.name: Dynamic Swarm Consensus Protocol
secrets.desc: Hybrid consensus blending time-windowed majority voting with priority-weighted nodes, resolving conflicting instructions and reassigning leadership within 100ms.

secrets.label: GDCP
secrets.name: GPS-Denied Collaborative Positioning
secrets.desc: Swarm members derive shared position from relative ranging and visual landmarks when satellite navigation is unavailable, holding formation inside structures and tunnels.

secrets.label: SASK
secrets.name: Sea-State Adaptive Station-Keeping
secrets.desc: Control response curves that hold position above a moving sea surface across varying swell and gust conditions without operator retuning.

secrets.label: CFAB
secrets.name: Corridor-Following Autonomy Behaviours
secrets.desc: Autonomous tracking of pipelines, conductors and haul roads at survey altitude, including junction handling and re-acquisition after occlusion.

secrets.label: IEMB
secrets.name: Interception Envelope Manoeuvre Behaviours
secrets.desc: Coordinated approach and shadowing behaviours for closing on an uncooperative airborne target and holding relative position while classification is confirmed.

secrets.label: SSNR
secrets.name: Sub-second Node Recovery
secrets.desc: Mesh re-routing and handshake compression enabling degraded-link node reintegration in under one second without mission interruption.

secrets.label: FAMH
secrets.name: Frequency-Agile Mesh Hopping
secrets.desc: Coordinated channel agility that preserves swarm cohesion under broadband interference, with rejoin behaviour for members that lose the hopping schedule.

secrets.label: FRRB
secrets.name: First-Responder Radio Bridging
secrets.desc: Interoperability layer that relays swarm telemetry onto incumbent emergency services radio networks without dedicated ground equipment.

secrets.label: OWRC
secrets.name: Over-Water Relay Chain
secrets.desc: Link budget and relay spacing method maintaining vessel-to-swarm connectivity beyond line of sight over open water.

secrets.label: SPGU
secrets.name: Silent Propulsion Geometry — Urban
secrets.desc: Propeller blade geometry and housing configuration reducing acoustic signature below 40dB at 20m in urban canyon reflective environments.

secrets.label: MCCP
secrets.name: Marine Corrosion Coating Process
secrets.desc: Coating chemistry and application sequence extending airframe and motor service life under continuous salt exposure and deck washdown.

secrets.label: TMEP
secrets.name: Thermal-Managed Endurance Pack
secrets.desc: Cell arrangement and thermal path design sustaining long survey sorties in high ambient temperature without derating.

secrets.label: DTRG
secrets.name: Debris-Tolerant Rotor Guard
secrets.desc: Guard geometry permitting contact with rubble, wiring and vegetation while preserving lift efficiency and controllability.

secrets.label: LORP
secrets.name: Low-Observable Radar Profile
secrets.desc: Airframe shaping and material stack reducing radar return of the platform across the bands used by common small-craft and shipborne sets.

secrets.label: ATAA
secrets.name: Adaptive Threat-Avoidance AI
secrets.desc: On-board inference classifying threats across RF, visual and acoustic channels, triggering evasion trajectories without ground control authorisation.

secrets.label: VTSC
secrets.name: Victim Thermal Signature Classifier
secrets.desc: Discriminates human thermal signatures from heated debris and residual fire in collapsed structures, prioritising search areas for ground teams.

secrets.label: HICM
secrets.name: Hostile Intent Classification Model
secrets.desc: Behavioural model separating hostile approach patterns from routine traffic — closing geometry, speed profile and formation — for both airborne and surface contacts.

secrets.label: SDRM
secrets.name: Structural Defect Recognition Model
secrets.desc: Detects corrosion, conductor wear, insulator damage and ground encroachment from survey imagery, generating ranked inspection findings.

secrets.label: SCWD
secrets.name: Small-Craft Wake Discriminator
secrets.desc: Identifies and tracks fast small craft against sea clutter by wake and motion signature at ranges where hull detection is unreliable.

secrets.label: STDP
secrets.name: Synthetic Training Data Pipeline
secrets.desc: Generation and curation pipeline producing labelled training corpora for every on-board model, including rare-event and degraded-sensor cases.

secrets.label: JWDP
secrets.name: Joint Swarm Deployment Protocols
secrets.desc: Multi-domain sequencing for simultaneous activation of heterogeneous swarm elements across air, ground and communications assets.

secrets.label: RDCS
secrets.name: Rapid Deploy — Collapsed Structure
secrets.desc: Field procedure taking a swarm from vehicle to interior search in under four minutes, including void entry ordering and team handover points.

secrets.label: MDLR
secrets.name: Moving-Deck Launch & Recovery
secrets.desc: Launch and recovery sequence for a pitching, rolling deck under way, including abort criteria and crew positioning.

secrets.label: SMPH
secrets.name: Survey Mission Planning Heuristics
secrets.desc: Planning rules balancing coverage, overlap, endurance and lighting to hit photogrammetric accuracy targets in a single sortie.

secrets.label: VPEP
secrets.name: Vessel Protection Escalation Procedure
secrets.desc: Graduated response doctrine for an approaching unidentified craft — observation, illumination, hailing and audible warning — with master’s authority gates at each step and incident logging.

secrets.label: ZLOO
secrets.name: Zero-Latency Operator Override Bridge
secrets.desc: Interrupt architecture ensuring operator commands propagate to all swarm nodes within one radio frame, overriding any autonomous consensus state.

secrets.label: SOMS
secrets.name: Single-Operator Multi-Swarm Interface
secrets.desc: Attention-management model letting one operator supervise several swarms by surfacing only decisions that require human authority.

secrets.label: DLOF
secrets.name: Degraded-Link Operator Feedback
secrets.desc: Interface behaviour communicating swarm state and confidence when telemetry is intermittent, avoiding false certainty during link loss.

secrets.label: EAAG
secrets.name: Engagement Authority Gate
secrets.desc: Authority model binding any deterrent action to an identified human decision-maker, with pre-action confirmation, immutable audit trail and hard interlocks against autonomous escalation.
